The card's "switch to compact and back to default" is read as "switch to standard and back to compact, still 36". 2. Column lines in the header, data rows and footer row, the same colour and weight as the row lines. The frozen-column edge keeps its scroll shadow (#35548); it has no divider at rest today and gets none.
3. The footer shows a faint 「+ 添加统计」 / "Add calculation" in every column without a calculation, always; the footer row stays 32 high. Readers without the right to change the view still see no entry.
4. Editing a cell keeps the row at 36 (#36023's rule), measured in the browser.
